title: Signs in Milk, Honey and Birds

paragraphs.text: Allah sends rain and brings dead land back to life. From the bellies of cattle He gives you pure milk that is pleasant to drink. From palm trees and grapes you make drinks and good food. Your Lord inspired the bee to make homes in mountains, trees and buildings. It eats from all fruits. From its belly comes a drink of many colors. In it there is healing for people.

Allah creates you and then takes you in death. Some live to a very weak old age and forget what they knew. Allah gave some people more provision than others. He gave you spouses, children and grandchildren. Yet some people worship things that cannot provide anything. Allah gives examples. Is a helpless slave equal to a free man who spends in secret and in public? Is a man who can do nothing equal to one who orders justice?

The coming of the Hour is like a blink of the eye. Allah brought you out of your mothers knowing nothing. He gave you hearing, sight and minds. Only Allah holds up the birds in the sky. He gave you homes, tents of animal skin, and clothes for heat and battle.

hardWords.m: a quick closing and opening of the eye
